underlines.text: there was no escaping the frequent mention of Wickham’s name

reference.text: Well, but now for my news: it is about dear Wickham; too good for the waiter, is not it?

underlines.text: we treated the other three with the nicest cold luncheon in the world

reference.text: After welcoming their sisters, they triumphantly displayed a table set out with such cold meat as an inn larder usually affords, exclaiming, “Is not this nice?
